reason: The one-entry panel-helper proposals rank highest because the supplied feasibility review gives an exact structure and pointer mapping, though the 16-call version showed no repeatable gain and the assembly edits carry ABI and stack risks. Scratch lifetime is source-expressible but needs coordinated packing and traversal changes. The loop-control proposals rely on a two-K body that the supplied current full512 source does not have; related schedules were measured without promotion, so they rank lower. Panel packing adds allocation, copying, and traversal changes. Fused packing and a new transpose-aware primitive have the greatest implementation or preparation risk. No proposal has evidence of reaching 1800 GFLOP/s.
